terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; cd apps/hiveweave-py && uv run uvicorn hiveweave.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: React/Vite dev server on http://localhost:5173 (proxies /api to backend)
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo 'waiting for backend on :4000...'; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf http://localhost:4000/api/projects >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; pnpm dev
